Duration constant

While in a mixed frame, you no longer take Chrome-Bound's extra "+1 to all Load values" or Rejecting's extra "suppressed cybernetic needs an Interact to reboot every time" penalties (bio-augmentation.html §07). Every other listed effect of those bands still applies to you in full.
